answer: A sybil farmer's edge is disposability: identities cost nothing to spawn and nothing to abandon. Make time the unforgeable cost. Every new identity enters a maturation kernel: rewards escrow for 30 epochs of work, and each birth lands on a public cohort ledger — a prism refracting mass-spawning into plain view. During probation anyone may file correlation evidence (matching submit-times, template answers); a falcon-swift challenge that succeeds burns the cohort's escrow at once. Batch-spawning, the farmer's efficiency, becomes the evidence that kills the batch; restarting resets the clock.
